title: partition-presubmit-lint-plugins-and-add-lightweight-dev-images-with-release-narrowing
author: Maya Lin
description: Motivation: reduce presubmit latency and developer cycle time by decomposing the monolithic lint runner and introducing tiny developer images for fast local iteration. This change partitions lint plugins by language/runtime and introduces a release-narrowing premerge gate to avoid running expensive downstream checks when the change is unrelated to release-critical paths. Scope: refactors the presubmit runner to load plugin bundles per-path, adds devcontainer and thin CI images optimized for quick installs, and wires a conditional release-narrowing check that consults a lightweight path classifier. Checklist: 1) extract lint-plugin registry and partition loader; 2) add thin dev image Dockerfiles and minimal toolchain bundles; 3) add path classifier (heuristic-based) and premerge gating; 4) update presubmit docs and dev-runner flags; 5) preserve legacy runner as opt-in via PRESERVE_LEGACY_RUNNER env flag. Testing: local smoke runs for python/ts/rust lint shards, CI pipeline run in feature branch with staged presubmit lanes, canary merge to staging repo, and manual validation by reviewers. Rollout plan: merge to main behind feature flag, enable on 10% of PRs via CI fastpath, monitor presubmit latency and false-positive rate for 2 weeks, then promote to 100% and deprecate legacy runner. Risk/mitigation: path classifier may underclassify, which would skip some expensive checks; mitigated by conservative defaults (treat unknown paths as release-critical) and a manual fallback that forces full presubmit. Migration notes: minimal changes required for devs—devcontainer images exposed as .devcontainer/quick-{py,ts,rust} and new make targets make dev-fast and make ci-thin. Related: ENG-2142 (presubmit partitioning), ENG-2207 (dev experience images). Release notes: presubmit latency improvements and new developer fast images; default presubmit behavior unchanged until rollout completes. CI details: initial run showed two flaky tests in ts-lint-shard fixed in follow-up commit. This PR retains all existing linters but changes the runtime loader and the CI orchestration to conditionally enqueue shards. Documentation: updated docs/presubmit.md and docs/devcontainers.md. Merge outcome: squash merged to main after final approval and green CI. For operational observability, added telemetry counters presubmit.partition.* and devimage.pull_latency.* to the CI telemetry namespace.
commits: refactor: add plugin partition loader (m. lin); feat(ci): add thin dev images and make targets; ci: wire path-classifier premerge gate; fix(ts): address flaky-lint test exposed by partitioning; docs: update presubmit and devcontainer guides
review_comments: Reviewer Omar: Please add a short description of the path classification heuristics and a fallback. Author Maya: added heuristics doc string and conservative fallback. Reviewer Priya: noted the devimage size could be reduced further; tracked as a follow-up task. Reviewer Luca: requested telemetry counters; added metrics_registry registration. CI note: initial CI failed lint in ts-shard due to new loader ordering; fixed in commit 'fix(ts): address flaky-lint test exposed by partitioning'. All reviewers approved after fixes.
release_notes: - Presubmit: partitioned lint plugins to reduce average presubmit latency. - Developer: new lightweight devcontainer images for fast iteration (make dev-fast). - CI: release-narrowing premerge gate reduces unnecessary expensive checks.
notes: This PR aims for minimal disruption: legacy runner can be re-enabled via PRESERVE_LEGACY_RUNNER=true. We will monitor telemetry presubmit.partition.latency and presubmit.partition.false_suppression_rate and revert gating if false suppression exceeds 0.5%. Follow-up work tracked in ENG-2299 to shrink devimage layer counts and ENG-2314 to add ML-based path classifier.
